qAndA.question: Why is the video titled 'The 22 Convention: Make Women Great Again'?

qAndA.answer: Through the juxtaposition of Anthony Dream Johnson's message with the critical reactions from women, the use of the Trump-inspired slogan, and the visual elements showcasing the all-male leadership of a convention aimed at women.
